title: Wand of Replication
description: Unleash the magic of duplication! The Wand of Replication lets you instantly copy blocks and small structures, making building faster and more efficient. An essential tool for every serious Minecraft builder.
body:
# ✨ Wand of Replication: Build Faster, Build Smarter

The **Wand of Replication** is a powerful plugin designed for builders and server admins who want to accelerate construction and terraforming without resorting to creative mode or complex external tools. This magical wand allows you to duplicate blocks and even small areas instantly, using resources directly from your inventory.

## ✨ Features

* **Custom Wand Item:** Obtain the **Wand of Replication** (based on a Blaze Rod) with unique name and lore.
* **Single Block Duplication:** Right-click a block while holding the wand to instantly place an exact duplicate next to it.
* **Area Replication (Coming Soon):** Future updates will enable selecting two points to duplicate entire small structures (e.g., a 3x3x3 area).
* **Resource Consumption:** Each replication consumes the necessary blocks from your inventory, ensuring fair gameplay.
* **Configurable Cooldowns:** Prevent spamming with customizable cooldowns on the wand's abilities.
* **Efficient Building:** Perfect for creating repetitive patterns, extending walls, or quickly filling in large areas.

## ⚙️ How to Use

1.  **Obtain the Wand:** A server administrator will typically use a command to give you the **Wand of Replication**.
    * **Command:** `/givewand`
2.  **Single Block Replication:**
    * Hold the **Wand of Replication**.
    * Right-click the block you wish to duplicate.
    * A duplicate will appear adjacent to the clicked block in the direction you are facing, consuming one item from your inventory.
3.  **Area Replication (Future Update):**
    * *Details will be provided with the update for multi-block duplication functionality.*

## 🚀 Get Building\!

Say goodbye to tedious manual placement\! The **Wand of Replication** is your new best friend for constructing magnificent creations with speed and precision.
